automated.summary: Deterministic verify is green across all three workspaces with the shell + login built. verify.py reports Verification passed across structural (build incl. next build, dual-runtime, vendor integrity), typecheck, quality (ESLint incl. eslint-config-next + Prettier) and test (backend hermetic + the ten frontend Vitest files + the guard). The seven task-required RTL/jsdom tests are DB-free with negative controls: 6-digit validation, per-POST 3f_csrf re-read, refresh-once-then-retry (and no-refresh on otp/verify 401), redirect-only-after-retry-fails, five-nav/only-Dashboard/disabled-items-make-no-API-calls, resend+use-different-email, and the mobile drawer aria-expanded/Escape/focus. The login was rendered on the dev server and reviewed faithful at 1440x900 and 390x844.

npm run test:hermetic  # backend 0 fail; frontend 10/10; guard 1 pass
